g.text: Mida Context — one memory you own. Every AI you authorize can use it.
Simplified architecture (P0). First proof shown here: a second AI agent continues the first one’s work. Same store, same rules, for any kind of context.
at most one save a minute;
always saves when the agent stops
A and B each sign with their own key
what you told Mida + where the work
stands, each line with its on-chain author
(who may read what, who wrote what)
every read is checked against the chain —
approve / revoke — owner transactions, signed by you
Tell one AI. Every AI you authorize can know. Start with one agent. Finish with another.
